How to play Spud Fling

Spud Fling is a one-button physics arcade game. Hold Space, Enter, mouse button, or touch to charge the slingshot (the power meter oscillates), then release to fling Spud. During flight, press again if you have unlocked Air Toot for a mid-air boost. After landing, press once more to reset and fling again. Smash crate towers for potato coins; unlocks happen automatically at coin thresholds. Single-player only — no accounts.

Controls

Keyboard

Hold Space or Enter to charge; release to launch. Press again in flight for Air Toot (once unlocked). Press after landing to reset.

Touch

Touch and hold anywhere to charge; release to launch. Tap again in flight for Air Toot (once unlocked). Tap after landing to reset.

Tips for Spud Fling

  • Release near the top of the charge oscillation for longer flights — the meter keeps moving while you hold.
  • Prioritize crate towers early; coins unlock Double Band and Bouncy Mushrooms that multiply later distance.
  • After Pond of Gulpo unlocks, aim flights over the pond near 95 m for the swallow-and-spit distance burst.
  • Golden Spud doubles coin gain — once you have it, farm crates to climb the remaining ladder faster.

Unlocks and goals

Spud Fling has six unlocks after the starting Rubber Band, and each one switches on by itself when your total potato coins reach its number. Coins come from smashing crates (2 each), bouncing on mushrooms (5), Gulpo's spit (100) and distance (half a coin per metre when Spud lands); Golden Spud doubles them all. Your coins and unlocks are saved in your browser.

How we made it

We built it with AI assistance: AI coding agents wrote its code from our instructions. Spud Fling is one small JavaScript file on top of the open-source three.js engine (r149, MIT), drawn with WebGL1. Every mesh, colour and sound in it, from the potato and crates to the trees and the frog, is generated by our own code; the game ships no art, audio or font files. The physics is our own few lines of code rather than a physics library. We test it in headless Chromium with software WebGL (SwiftShader), with a fast-forward mode that speeds up coin gain so the unlocks can be checked; we have not measured it on real phones yet.

FAQ

How do I play Spud Fling?

Hold Space, Enter, mouse, or touch to charge the slingshot, then release to fling Spud. Smash crates for coins, unlock boosts automatically, and chase a new best distance.

Do I need an account?

No. Spud Fling is free to play in the browser with no account and no cookies. Progress is stored only in this browser’s localStorage. No ads, no cookies, no scripts that track individuals; we only use cookie-free visit counting (Cloudflare Web Analytics, which sets no cookies and builds no personal profiles).

What are the unlocks?

Coin thresholds unlock Double Band, Bouncy Mushrooms, Air Toot, Pond of Gulpo, Mega Band, and Golden Spud. The next unlock is shown on the in-game HUD.

Does it work on phones?

Yes. Touch and hold to charge, release to launch. The same one-button loop works on touchscreens.

Is Spud Fling free?

Yes. It is a self-made Toolstack Lab browser game with no purchase required for the core loop.

Who made Spud Fling and what is the licence?

Toolstack Lab made it; the code and art are our own. Licence and source details are on our content policy page.
